item.text:
**4B.8 Research Note**
Bottom line: mostly negative. Erdoğan did not face a 2024 national transfer-of-power test, but the available evidence points away from genuine respect for term limits and successor rules: an ally openly floated a constitutional amendment to extend his tenure, and the government removed elected local officials after opposition victories. The only clear positive is that Erdoğan publicly described the March local vote as his “last” election and the opposition’s wins were initially allowed.

| Polarity | Title | Publisher | Date | Recoverable URL | Claim-level summary | IDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|---|
| Positive, limited | [Turkey’s Erdogan says March election will be his final, state media reports](https://theprint.in/world/turkeys-erdogan-says-march-election-will-be-his-final-state-media-reports/1994063/) | Reuters via ThePrint | 2024-03-09 | https://theprint.in/world/turkeys-erdogan-says-march-election-will-be-his-final-state-media-reports/1994063/ | Erdoğan publicly said the March local vote would be his last election and framed the result as a legacy transfer. This is weak but real evidence of verbal acknowledgment of term-limit/succession rules. | 4B.8 |
| Positive, limited | [Turkey’s resurgent opposition thumps Erdogan in pivotal local elections](https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/turkeys-resurgent-opposition-thumps-erdogan-pivotal-local-elections-2024-03-31/) | Reuters | 2024-04-01 | https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/turkeys-resurgent-opposition-thumps-erdogan-pivotal-local-elections-2024-03-31/ | Opposition victories in Istanbul, Ankara, and many cities show local power was transferred through elections at least initially. That is evidence of some respect for electoral succession at the municipal level. | 4B.8; 4B.1 |
| Negative | [Erdogan ally floats Turkey constitutional amendment to let him extend his tenure](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/erdogan-ally-floats-turkey-constitutional-amendment-to-let-him-extend-his-tenure-3701715) | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-11-05 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/erdogan-ally-floats-turkey-constitutional-amendment-to-let-him-extend-his-tenure-3701715 | Erdoğan’s main ally, MHP leader Bahçeli, said a constitutional amendment should be considered to let Erdoğan run again in 2028, despite the constitution making 2028 his last scheduled term absent early elections. This is strong evidence against term-limit restraint. | 4B.8; 4B.5 |
| Negative | [Turkey removes two more pro-Kurdish mayors from office for links to banned group](https://apnews.com/article/3c6c33fd7fa2d86c9dc34089e6a98c9b) | Associated Press | 2024-11-22 | https://apnews.com/article/3c6c33fd7fa2d86c9dc34089e6a98c9b | After local election wins, elected mayors were removed and replaced with state appointees. This shows disregard for local electoral mandates and weak respect for constitutional transfer of power at the local level. | 4B.8; 4B.1; 4B.4 |
| Negative | [Türkiye: Government Removes Elected Opposition Mayors](https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/11/07/turkiye-government-removes-elected-opposition-mayors) | Human Rights Watch | 2024-11-07 | https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/11/07/turkiye-government-removes-elected-opposition-mayors | HRW says removing elected mayors and dissolving councils violates free and fair elections and is part of a repeated pattern of neutralizing opposition victories through “terrorism” allegations. That is direct evidence against respecting transfer rules when power changes hands. | 4B.8; 4B.1; 4B.4 |
| Negative / contextual | [Turkey: Freedom in the World 2024 Country Report](https://freedomhouse.org/country/turkey/freedom-world/2024) | Freedom House | 2024 | https://freedomhouse.org/country/turkey/freedom-world/2024 | Freedom House says Erdoğan and the AKP have consolidated power through constitutional changes, control the legislature, and intervene against bodies that resist them. That is broader context for why term-limit and succession commitments are not credible. | 4B.8; 4B.4; 4B.5 |

**Search gap**
I did not find a clean 2024 case of Erdoğan peacefully handing over national executive power, because the presidency was not up for transfer in 2024. The evidence is instead indirect: term-limit rhetoric versus active coalition talk about extending his tenure, plus post-election local reversals.
